title: caroxylon marginatum
intro: Caroxylon marginatum, commonly known as the "Saltbush", is a shrub-like plant species native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating arthritis symptoms, and providing relief from fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents present in Caroxylon marginatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic benefits.
